notes.title: Camera changes, various bug fixes
notes.notes:
- In order for Write 'n' Fight to be more fighty we've changed camera's field of view so the game would look a bit less like a platformer. Now you can read the expressions of anger and pain on the faces better!
- Fixed a bug that caused Mark Twain to perform a superjump after dash
- Akutagawa Ryunosuke's Kawarimi no Jutsu can no longer teleport him behind the wall
- Various other bug fixes

notes.title: More bug fixes!
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that caused players to be able to spam range attacks while crouching with various characters.
- Fixed a bug that caused players to be able to perform infinite jumps while in a local game.
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash while attacking Latin American Author who's using Frost Armor Skill

notes.title: Balance changes!
notes.notes:
- Since Alexandre Dumas got only one skill at the moment, we substantially increased his overall damage from all normal attacks and reduced cooldown of his skill. 
- William Shakespeare's unblockable Ground Stomp now deals more damage, have a bigger hurtbox, launches enemy further and cools down a bit faster
- Alessandro Manzoni's Vortex Dance now deals more damage
- Lovecraft's Skill 4 is no longer unblockable. 
- Latin American Author's handstand kicks damage is now lower.
- For Latin American Author and James Joyce jump kick should be much easier
- Fixed a bug that would cause Leo Tolstoy to freeze mid-air.
- Wall collision bug fixes
- Various smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Even more performance! Numerous bug fixes!
notes.notes:
- Like an unstoppable train, Leo Tolstoy was too good at bashing his opponents through the walls of the arenas. So we've nerfed that ability not just for him, but for every chatacer in the game. No more punching people through the walls!
- Game options are now always saved properly.
- Moving characters are now stopping after being freezed by Latin Author's skill.
- No more giant blocking Shakespeare (yes that was a thing)
- AI shouldn't freeze after being knocked down now
- Even faster loading, better performance
- Numerous other bug fixes

notes.title: Hyperjump bug fixes
notes.notes:
So, we all got a chance to float around the air for some time(If you hadn't - good for you). Well time's up... sort of.
We liked the idea of players exploiting skill animation cancel to get double or even triple jumps. However, now it will not be infinite. Some characters can still do it 2 or 3 times, but the majority of them can't. Maybe the idea of double jumps will be explored further down the line.

notes.title: Another big update!
notes.notes:
- Due to change in the lighting optimization the game is running much smoother across all the platforms. Loading is now faster, faster transitions between levels.
- Fixed the bug that was causing immobility of Player 1 that was hosting an online match,
- Fixed the bug that was causing an incorrect work of the tentacles on Lovecraft's Magic Arena
- Fixed the bug that was causing desync of Player 1 after being knocked down

notes.title: Huge Update of Main Game Modes
notes.notes: Huge update of main game modes: vsP2 Mode, vs AI Mode, x2 Speed Mode, Prophet Mode, KO Chess Mode, Tower, Tower with KO Chess Mode, Multiplayer with Rollback.

notes.title: Demo Update is now live!
notes.notes:
Write 'n' Fight Demo v0.8.14:
- Initial loading time is now substantially decreased
- Overall performance is improved due to dynamic sprite resizing
- Upgraded Hit Effects
- Fixed the bug causing characters to freeze during attacks
- Fixed The bug causing the timer to freeze at the begining of the round 
- Player's health now remains at the same level when characters teleport to the magic arenas
- Rounds are now properly counted when traveling to the magic arena
- If a player loses the round on magic arena - both players are teleported back to the main arena

 Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
- Introducing KO Chess mode:
Each Player can knock the opponent with one hit. If Player1 is overlapping the the upper Red KO zone, he can get knocked out hith a high attach. If he's overlapping the lower one - can get knocked out hith mid or low.
- Fixied the issues with counting Round 4 twice
- Fixed the new round freezing on Tolstoy's death

In the next Hotfix:
We've learned that some players can have infinite loading screen even after the magic arena level is loaded. We've also learned that some players can have issues with the AI looping. We are currently solving them.
